title: ARMOUR FITS A CURVED BODY
why: From the build design review of 2026-10-08: an Armour Plate was drawn as the same steel box on every body, so on a Curved body it hid her waist and chest. On Curved the plate is cut to her outline and the chest is moulded into the steel, moving with her; the shoulder plates and collar of the heavier tiers are as before.
now: Armour plates follow a Curved figure instead of boxing it in.
